derived_from: specs/stills-film-01-r2.json (unchanged); same 77 keys, scene content and story beats
hardening: FLUX.1-schnell runs at guidance 0 with no negative prompt and tends to draw what is named: every negation ('No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no extra fingers, no modern objects', 'no lamp', 'no jewellery') is removed and said positively (bare plaster wall, bare ears, neck and wrists, lit only by oil lamps, candles, moon and sun, empty-handed in darkness)

prompt order follows world-bible prompt_order (subject first, then the style preamble); the subject is framed as 'Gouache painting of <subject>' so the medium sits inside CLIP's 77-token window and one look dominates the whole film; the style clause always opens with 'Hand-painted gouache illustration' and is identical in all 77 prompts

each character's fixed signature comes first, positively: Hemshashi a child widow in a plain undyed white borderless sari with bare forehead, ears, neck and wrists; Kshiroda with a bare forehead so the mole below the left eye is her mark; young Mohit in 1880 Victorian dress with plain shirt cuffs; Judge Mohit clean-shaven with a smooth bare chin and upper lip
period anchors on every beat that showed drift: lime-plastered brick, green wooden shutters, beaten-earth lanes, clay and brass oil lamps, cut-glass decanter instead of stemmed glasses
prompts kept under 170 words so the whole prompt fits max_sequence_length 256 (T5)
seeds: chunk-2 keys (never generated) keep their seeds; replaced chunk-1 keys use seed + 10000 (same family per character); the composite f01s019-3 keeps 2101
